text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити becomes aware of her
reputation
through her friend Tosen
Jordan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her fans seem excited by her prospects,

particularly the possibility of her aiming
for the
Triple Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She receives support even from her
manager, who
was initially reluctant
about her becoming a
runner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The unexpected positive reaction from
everyone
provides a boost to her morale.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
